description: Lists files in the account's library, newest first: the path of each (out/...), its size and when it changed. Pictures, video, audio and fonts only. Free. Footage is added at https://ugc.fans/library; the path is what the clip and transcript tools take as source.

limit.description: How many files to list, newest first.

prefix.description: Only paths that start with this, such as out/api/images. The default is the whole library, out.

name: ugcfans_list_files
title: List files in the library
